p1_b3.ocr: Siegel 2014 [7] shows all parameters as Yes, leading to a low appraisal of potential bias. Similarly, Cubukcu 2014 [10], Canhoroz 2014 [24], Lee 2014 [9], and Shin 2014 [8] all maintain study participation, study attrition, prognostic factor measurement, outcome measurement, confounding measurement, and analysis approaches as Yes, resulting in a low bias appraisal for each. In contrast, Kerenidi 2013 [11] has study participation, study attrition, and prognostic factor measurement as Yes, but shows outcome measurement as Partly, confounding measurement and account as No, and analysis approaches as Yes, culminating in a high bias appraisal.
